title: BreastUS-CAD: frozen, pre-registered single-shot external validation of a breast ultrasound benign/malignant classifier, with deployment-oriented follow-up studies and an independent audit trail
description:
Code, protocols, results and audit trail of BreastUS-CAD; frozen model weights on Hugging Face.

Research prototype — not a medical device. A ViT-B/16 classifier trained on the public BUS-BRA dataset with the official patient-level five-fold splits, frozen (git tag frozen-v1) and validated single-shot on four external cohorts (BrEaST, Curated BUSI, GDPH, SYSUCC) under an internally version-controlled pre-registered protocol (data/external_protocol.md + 4 amendments), followed by pre-registered deployment-oriented studies (site-specific recalibration, ensemble-disagreement abstention, domain-pretrained backbone, leave-one-cohort-out multi-source training), an independent adversarial audit (docs/AUDIT_2026-09-06.md), the item-by-item response, and post-hoc analyses quantifying the disclosed biases. Every number in RESULTS.md recomputes from the committed CSV/JSON artifacts. Model checkpoints are not in this archive: frozen-v1 weights (repo root) and v2 research checkpoints (v2/) are on Hugging Face with SHA-256 checksums in models/CHECKSUMS.txt. Pre-registration was internal and not externally time-stamped before this deposition; see docs/PROVENANCE.md.
